title: A room with a sea view
goal: Say whose with -(y)An (babası doktor olan çocuk, bahçesi olan bir ev) and recognize aorist participles such as çalar saat and çıkmaz sokak.

intro.text: For **whose**, give the subject inside the clause a possessive: *babası doktor olan çocuk* (the child whose father is a doctor), *bahçesi olan bir ev* (a house with a garden). The aorist also makes a few fixed adjectives: *çalar saat* (alarm clock), *çıkmaz sokak* (dead end).

vocab.en: to get lost, to go missing

exercises.question: How do you say **the child whose father is a doctor**?

why.1: The father is the child's: *babası*, with the possessive ending.
why.2: Everything that describes the noun comes before it.

exercises.explain: *Babası* points to the child; *doktor olan* turns **is a doctor** into a participle.

exercises.text: Penceresi denize bak___ bir oda istiyoruz.
exercises.en: We'd like a room with a window onto the sea.

reject.why: Before a noun, use the participle: *denize bakan bir oda*.

exercises.explain: *penceresi* (its window) + *denize bakan* (looking at the sea): **a room whose window looks onto the sea**.

accept: The woman whose cat got lost is very sad.
The woman whose cat [is lost|is missing|went missing|has gone missing|disappeared|has disappeared] is very [sad|upset].
The woman whose cat got lost is very upset.

exercises.prompt: We are looking for a house with a garden.

reject.why: The garden belongs to the house: *bahçesi olan bir ev*, with the possessive ending.

exercises.gloss: not having (arabası … komşu: the neighbour who has no car)
exercises.explain: Negative *-ma*, buffer y, then *-an*: *ol-ma-y-an*. *Arabası olmayan* comes from *arabası yok*.

exercises.en: My alarm clock didn't go off this morning.
This street is a dead end; you can't get out this way.
exercises.explain: *Çıkmaz sokak*: the negative aorist as an adjective, **a street that doesn't come out**.

exercises.prompt: Who is the author of this book?
Do you have a ballpoint pen?

exercises.tr: Annesi Türk olan bir arkadaşım var.
exercises.en: I have a friend whose mother is Turkish.
options: Annesi Türk olan bir arkadaşım var.
Annesi Türk olmayan bir arkadaşım var.

exercises.question: The proverb *Görünen köy kılavuz istemez* means:
exercises.explain: Literally **the village you can see needs no guide**: *görünen* is `-(y)An`, *istemez* the negative aorist. Say it when something is obvious.

exercises.prompt: The man with a beard is my uncle.
